  <!-- ================= FINAL VIGNETTE & Sfumato GLOW ================= -->

prompt: Draw the Mona Lisa as an SVG.
content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 1000" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Lighting Filters for Sfumato Effect -->
    <filter id="sfumato-blur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8" />
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft-shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" />
    </filter>
    <filter id="fine-blur" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" />
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Canvas Texture / Vignette -->
    <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0" />
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#120a02" stop-opacity="0.4" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#050200" stop-opacity="0.8" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Sky & Background Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#728a7c" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#919e8b" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#babb9b" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a422d" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="waterGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2d4239" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#465e52" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#273830" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Skin Gradients -->
    <radialGradient id="faceBase" cx="45%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe3c4" />
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#e6c29c" />
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#be9368" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7a5230" />
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="neckGrad" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8c49e" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#c49a72" />
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#7e5432" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#422510" />
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="cheekGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d9826c" stop-opacity="0.35" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c49a72" stop-opacity="0" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Eye & Lip Gradients -->
    <radialGradient id="irisGrad" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a4d31" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#2b2413" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0b06" />
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="lipGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#aa5c4f" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#8c3b2d" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#592017" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Dress Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="dressGreen" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3b422e" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#21261a" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d100b" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="sleeveGold" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c29b53" />
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#9e7731" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#5e4314" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#241804" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="veilGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.25" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#2b231d" stop-opacity="0.15" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.6" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ================= BACKGROUND LAYER ================= -->
  <g id="background">
    <!-- Sky Base -->
    <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="url(#skyGrad)" />

    <!-- Distant Mountains (Left & Right) -->
    <!-- Far misty peaks -->
    <path d="M0,450 Q120,420 220,440 T380,430 L400,550 L0,550 Z" fill="#5b7365" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
    <path d="M420,440 Q550,400 680,430 T800,410 L800,550 L420,550 Z" fill="#4d6356" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />

    <!-- Mid-ground jagged rocks & paths -->
    <!-- Left Side Landscape -->
    <path d="M0,480 Q80,460 150,510 T280,530 L320,620 L0,620 Z" fill="#394a32" />
    <path d="M30,500 Q90,480 130,530 T200,580" fill="none" stroke="#8a7d53" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#fine-blur)" /> <!-- Winding path -->
    
    <!-- Right Side Landscape with Bridge -->
    <path d="M480,520 Q580,470 700,500 T800,470 L800,650 L450,650 Z" fill="#2c3b27" />
    <!-- Distant Bridge (Right) -->
    <g id="bridge" fill="#524934" opacity="0.7">
      <rect x="620" y="525" width="80" height="15" rx="2" />
      <path d="M625,540 A8,8 0 0,0 639,540 A8,8 0 0,0 653,540 A8,8 0 0,0 667,540 A8,8 0 0,0 681,540 A8,8 0 0,0 695,540" fill="#1d2419" />
    </g>

    <!-- Water / Bodies of light -->
    <path d="M160,520 Q200,510 250,530 T290,560 L200,570 Z" fill="url(#waterGrad)" opacity="0.7" />
    <path d="M500,530 Q580,540 620,525 L650,550 Q570,560 480,540 Z" fill="url(#waterGrad)" opacity="0.8" />

    <!-- Closer Dark Rocks / Earth Base -->
    <path d="M0,580 Q180,550 350,600 L350,750 L0,750 Z" fill="#1c2414" />
    <path d="M450,590 Q620,540 800,570 L800,750 L450,750 Z" fill="#182112" />

    <!-- Loggia / Balustrade Sill & Columns (Flanking sides) -->
    <rect x="0" y="680" width="800" height="320" fill="#0d0905" />
    <!-- Column Base Left -->
    <path d="M0,500 L35,500 L45,700 L0,700 Z" fill="#17120c" opacity="0.8" />
    <path d="M35,500 L40,500 L50,700 L45,700 Z" fill="#2d2419" opacity="0.5" />
    <!-- Column Base Right -->
    <path d="M765,500 L800,500 L800,700 L755,700 Z" fill="#17120c" opacity="0.8" />
    <path d="M760,500 L765,500 L755,700 L750,700 Z" fill="#2d2419" opacity="0.5" />
    <!-- Armrest / Chair Edge -->
    <path d="M120,740 C250,760 550,760 680,740 C700,800 680,880 670,900 L130,900 Z" fill="#140d07" />
  </g>

  <!-- ================= MONA LISA FIGURE ================= -->
  <g id="mona-lisa">
    
    <!-- BACK HAIR -->
    <g id="back-hair">
      <path d="M280,240 C260,320 250,420 270,500 C280,540 310,600 310,600 C310,600 230,480 230,360 C230,280 270,210 280,240 Z" fill="#0f0b07" />
      <path d="M520,240 C540,320 550,420 530,500 C520,540 490,600 490,600 C490,600 570,480 570,360 C570,280 530,210 520,240 Z" fill="#0f0b07" />
    </g>

    <!-- TORSO & DRESS (Base Layers) -->
    <g id="dress-body">
      <!-- Main Dark Dress Back -->
      <path d="M240,520 C270,460 330,440 400,440 C470,440 530,460 560,520 L640,750 C650,820 660,900 660,1000 L140,1000 C140,900 150,820 160,750 Z" fill="url(#dressGreen)" />
      
      <!-- Pleated Under-bodice / Chemise (White/Cream) -->
      <path d="M330,440 Q400,470 470,440 L480,480 Q400,530 320,480 Z" fill="#d9c5a0" opacity="0.8" />
      <!-- Fine pleats texture -->
      <path d="M340,448 L345,490 M360,454 L365,502 M380,458 L382,508 M400,460 L400,510 M420,458 L418,508 M440,454 L435,502 M460,448 L455,490" stroke="#8c7652" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6" />

      <!-- Dress Embroided Border (Golden Terracotta Trim) -->
      <path d="M315,455 C340,500 460,500 485,455 C475,440 325,440 315,455 Z" fill="#8c5828" stroke="#cca462" stroke-width="2" />
      <!-- Embroidery Pattern (Interlocking loops simplified) -->
      <path d="M325,455 Q400,510 475,455" fill="none" stroke="#e0c07b" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />
      <path d="M330,450 Q400,500 470,450" fill="none" stroke="#522f13" stroke-width="2" />

      <!-- Draped Robe / Shawl over Shoulders (Gown folds) -->
      <!-- Left Shoulder Drapery -->
      <path d="M190,580 C210,500 280,450 320,450 C300,520 280,600 300,680 C250,660 200,620 190,580 Z" fill="#2b2118" />
      <path d="M220,540 C250,580 270,640 290,700" fill="none" stroke="#423428" stroke-width="12" filter="url(#soft-shadow)" />

      <!-- Right Shoulder / Arm Drapery (Yellowish-Gold Sleeve) -->
      <g id="right-sleeve">
        <path d="M480,450 C520,450 590,500 610,580 C600,620 570,660 520,670 C510,610 500,540 480,450 Z" fill="url(#sleeveGold)" />
        <!-- Folds on Sleeve -->
        <path d="M500,480 C540,520 570,570 560,630" fill="none" stroke="#3d2a0a" stroke-width="8" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <path d="M520,465 C560,500 590,550 585,600" fill="none" stroke="#dcb262" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <path d="M485,510 C520,550 540,610 530,660" fill="none" stroke="#241703" stroke-width="10" filter="url(#soft-shadow)" />
      </g>

      <!-- Left Sleeve (Lower Ochre/Gold Section) -->
      <g id="left-sleeve">
        <path d="M260,630 C300,620 340,650 350,700 C310,720 260,700 240,660 Z" fill="url(#sleeveGold)" />
        <path d="M270,640 C300,650 330,680 340,700" fill="none" stroke="#3d2a0a" stroke-width="6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- NECK & DECOLLETAGE -->
    <g id="neck-chest">
      <path d="M330,360 C320,420 330,465 400,465 C470,465 480,420 470,360 Z" fill="url(#neckGrad)" />
      <!-- Shadow at the neckline base -->
      <path d="M320,455 C370,480 430,480 480,455 C460,440 340,440 320,455 Z" fill="#3b200c" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#soft-shadow)" />
      <!-- Collarbone soft definition -->
      <path d="M350,420 Q400,435 450,420" fill="none" stroke="#a37651" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />
    </g>

    <!-- HEAD & FACE -->
    <g id="head">
      <!-- Base Head Structure -->
      <path id="face-shape" d="M315,240 C310,140 490,140 485,240 C485,315 465,370 400,370 C335,370 315,315 315,240 Z" fill="url(#faceBase)" />

      <!-- Sfumato Shadow Overlays (Face Contours) -->
      <!-- Jaw & Chin Shadows -->
      <path d="M315,260 C320,330 350,375 400,375 C450,375 480,330 485,260 C485,340 445,390 400,390 C355,390 315,340 315,260 Z" fill="#52331b" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />
      <!-- Left Side Face Shadow (Viewer's left - shaded side) -->
      <path d="M315,200 C310,260 325,320 350,350 C330,310 320,250 325,200 Z" fill="#422510" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />
      <!-- Right Cheek Highlight -->
      <ellipse cx="435" cy="270" rx="35" ry="45" fill="url(#cheekGlow)" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />
      <!-- Left Cheek Soft Glow -->
      <ellipse cx="365" cy="275" rx="30" ry="40" fill="url(#cheekGlow)" opacity="0.7" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />

      <!-- NOSE -->
      <g id="nose">
        <!-- Nose Bridge Shadow (Left side) -->
        <path d="M388,235 C385,260 380,280 375,295 C383,298 390,298 395,295 C392,280 393,260 394,235 Z" fill="#a87a56" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <!-- Nose Highlight -->
        <path d="M392,235 Q390,270 388,293" fill="none" stroke="#fff0db" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <!-- Nose Tip & Nostrils -->
        <path d="M375,295 C380,302 387,304 397,303 C405,302 412,296 412,296 C412,296 404,292 396,293 C388,292 375,295 375,295 Z" fill="#7a4b27" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <!-- Soft Nostril Shadows -->
        <ellipse cx="380" cy="297" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#2d1708" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <ellipse cx="405" cy="296" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#2d1708" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
      </g>

      <!-- EYES -->
      <!-- Mona Lisa is famous for no pronounced eyebrows, so brows are extremely faint/absent -->
      <g id="eyebrows" opacity="0.15" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)">
        <path d="M340,225 Q365,218 390,226" fill="none" stroke="#422510" stroke-width="5" />
        <path d="M410,226 Q435,218 460,225" fill="none" stroke="#422510" stroke-width="5" />
      </g>

      <g id="eyes">
        <!-- LEFT EYE (Viewer's Left) -->
        <g id="left-eye">
          <!-- Eye Socket Shadow -->
          <ellipse cx="362" cy="240" rx="20" ry="12" fill="#694327" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
          <!-- Eyeball White (Subdued/Warm) -->
          <path d="M348,241 Q362,233 378,241 Q362,248 348,241 Z" fill="#ebd9c5" />
          <path d="M348,241 Q362,233 378,241 Q362,248 348,241 Z" fill="#734f34" opacity="0.2" />
          <!-- Iris -->
          <circle cx="363" cy="241" r="6.5" fill="url(#irisGrad)" />
          <!-- Pupil -->
          <circle cx="363" cy="241" r="3" fill="#0a0805" />
          <!-- Catchlight (Very subtle) -->
          <circle cx="361" cy="239" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" />
          <!-- Eyelids & Lashing Shadow -->
          <path d="M346,241 Q362,231 380,240" fill="none" stroke="#331c0c" stroke-width="2.5" />
          <path d="M348,241 Q362,249 378,241" fill="none" stroke="#5e391e" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" />
          <!-- Upper Lid Fold -->
          <path d="M345,236 Q362,228 379,235" fill="none" stroke="#4a2d17" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
        </g>

        <!-- RIGHT EYE (Viewer's Right) -->
        <g id="right-eye">
          <!-- Eye Socket Shadow -->
          <ellipse cx="432" cy="240" rx="20" ry="12" fill="#694327" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
          <!-- Eyeball White -->
          <path d="M418,241 Q432,233 448,241 Q432,248 418,241 Z" fill="#ebd9c5" />
          <path d="M418,241 Q432,233 448,241 Q432,248 418,241 Z" fill="#734f34" opacity="0.2" />
          <!-- Iris -->
          <circle cx="431" cy="241" r="6.5" fill="url(#irisGrad)" />
          <!-- Pupil -->
          <circle cx="431" cy="241" r="3" fill="#0a0805" />
          <!-- Catchlight -->
          <circle cx="429" cy="239" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" />
          <!-- Eyelids & Lashing Shadow -->
          <path d="M416,241 Q432,231 450,240" fill="none" stroke="#331c0c" stroke-width="2.5" />
          <path d="M418,241 Q432,249 448,241" fill="none" stroke="#5e391e" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" />
          <!-- Upper Lid Fold -->
          <path d="M415,236 Q432,228 449,235" fill="none" stroke="#4a2d17" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- MOUTH & SMILE (The Enigmatic Smile) -->
      <g id="mouth">
        <!-- Outer Smile Shadow (Creates the illusion/sfumato warmth) -->
        <ellipse cx="395" cy="336" rx="26" ry="12" fill="#783d27" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)" />
        
        <!-- Upper Lip -->
        <path d="M372,334 C382,330 390,332 395,333 C400,332 408,330 418,334 C410,338 400,339 395,338 C390,339 380,338 372,334 Z" fill="url(#lipGrad)" />
        
        <!-- Lower Lip -->
        <path d="M375,335 C385,339 390,344 395,344 C400,344 405,339 415,335 C408,342 399,347 395,347 C391,347 382,342 375,335 Z" fill="url(#lipGrad)" opacity="0.9" />
        <path d="M382,338 Q395,345 408,338" fill="none" stroke="#fce4ce" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />

        <!-- Center Mouth Line (Extends subtly into cheeks for the smile) -->
        <path d="M368,333 C378,334 390,336 395,336 C400,336 412,334 422,332" fill="none" stroke="#2b1005" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        
        <!-- Corner Depressions (Key to the enigmatic expression) -->
        <circle cx="369" cy="333" r="2.5" fill="#3b1306" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
        <circle cx="421" cy="332" r="2" fill="#3b1306" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
      </g>
    </g> <!-- End Head -->

    <!-- FRONT HAIR & VEIL -->
    <g id="front-hair-and-veil">
      <!-- Wavy Tresses Framing Face -->
      <!-- Left Locks -->
      <path d="M325,190 C310,220 305,260 312,300 C318,330 325,370 315,420 C305,470 270,520 270,520 C270,520 290,460 295,410 C300,360 295,320 290,280 C285,240 300,200 325,190 Z" fill="#24180e" />
      <path d="M315,240 C310,280 318,330 310,380" fill="none" stroke="#523922" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" />
      <path d="M305,280 C300,320 308,370 295,430" fill="none" stroke="#422d1b" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5" />

      <!-- Right Locks -->
      <path d="M475,190 C490,220 495,260 488,300 C482,330 475,370 485,420 C495,470 530,520 530,520 C530,520 510,460 505,410 C500,360 505,320 510,280 C515,240 500,200 475,190 Z" fill="#1c120a" />
      <path d="M485,240 C490,280 482,330 490,380" fill="none" stroke="#523922" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" />
      
      <!-- Top Hair Center Parting -->
      <path d="M400,163 C370,165 330,180 320,210 C340,190 380,178 400,178 C420,178 460,190 480,210 C470,180 430,165 400,163 Z" fill="#291a0e" />
      <line x1="400" y1="165" x2="400" y2="185" stroke="#120a04" stroke-width="1.5" />

      <!-- Transparent Veil Over Top of Head and Shoulders -->
      <path d="M310,180 C350,160 450,160 490,180 C520,220 540,300 550,400 C560,500 570,600 570,600 L230,600 C230,600 240,500 250,400 C260,300 280,220 310,180 Z" fill="url(#veilGrad)" />
      <!-- Delicate Veil Edge across Forehead -->
      <path d="M320,195 Q400,180 480,195" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.4" />
    </g>

    <!-- FOREGROUND HANDS & ARMS (Iconic Crossed Position) -->
    <g id="hands">
      <!-- Right Arm/Wrist Base (Positioned Resting on Chair/Lap) -->
      <path d="M520,670 C470,680 400,720 350,750 C320,770 280,820 260,860 C300,890 380,870 430,830 C480,790 540,730 550,700 Z" fill="url(#neckGrad)" />

      <!-- Left Hand (Underneath, Resting on Armrest) -->
      <g id="left-hand">
        <!-- Wrapped Fingers around Chair Rest -->
        <path d="M250,830 C240,840 240,860 250,870 C260,880 280,880 290,860 C295,850 285,830 270,825 Z" fill="#d4a87e" />

        <path d="M295,845 C290,860 295,875 305,885 C315,890 325,880 330,865 C330,850 315,840 305,840 Z" fill="#e0b890" />

      <!-- Right Hand (On Top, Gently Resting over Left Wrist) -->

        <!-- Main Hand Mass / Back of Hand -->
        <path d="M440,720 C390,720 340,750 310,780 C300,795 310,815 330,815 C370,810 420,770 460,740 Z" fill="#eed2b3" />
        <!-- Soft Shadow on Back of Hand -->
        <path d="M340,770 C380,750 430,730 450,735 C430,755 380,780 340,770 Z" fill="#b38359" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />

        <!-- Smooth Graceful Fingers -->

        <path d="M220,830 C240,820 280,795 320,788" fill="none" stroke="#a67751" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5" />

        <!-- Middle Finger (Longest, elegant curve) -->
        <path d="M315,790 C270,805 225,835 215,850 C210,858 220,865 230,860 C245,848 290,818 330,802 Z" fill="#ebd0b0" />
        <path d="M215,850 C235,838 280,810 325,800" fill="none" stroke="#a67751" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5" />

        <!-- Ring Finger -->
        <path d="M325,800 C285,820 245,855 235,868 C230,875 240,880 250,875 C265,862 300,832 338,810 Z" fill="#e2c2a1" />

        <!-- Little Finger -->
        <path d="M335,808 C305,830 270,865 260,878 C255,884 265,888 273,883 C285,872 315,842 348,818 Z" fill="#d6b28d" />

        <!-- Thumb (Tucked neatly) -->
        <path d="M360,740 C340,755 330,770 335,780 C345,785 365,770 380,755 Z" fill="#e3c2a1" />

        <!-- Shadows between fingers for depth -->
        <path d="M235,840 L225,850 M245,860 L238,870 M260,875 L255,882" stroke="#784d2a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#fine-blur)" />
      </g>
    </g>
  </g> <!-- End Mona Lisa Figure -->

  <!-- ================= OVERLAYS & GLAZE ================= -->
  <!-- Warm Renaissance Lighting Glaze -->
  <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="#784e1b" opacity="0.08" style="mix-blend-mode: color-burn;" />

content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 1200" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradients -->

      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#7d8f78"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a89f74"/>

    <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="60%">

    <linearGradient id="waterGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#406361"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#678c85"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3d5955"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="roadGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#806d48"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4d4229"/>

    <!-- Balcony/Loggia Gradients -->

      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#3d332a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#191410"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Hair Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="hairHalo" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2a1a0e"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#150d08"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#080402"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="veilGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#8a8470" stop-opacity="0.1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Skin Master Gradients (Sfumato) -->
    <radialGradient id="foreheadLight" cx="45%" cy="35%" r="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffebb8"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#e3c794"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#bd9865"/>
      <stop offset="90%" stop-color="#8c653d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#573c23"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="noseLight" cx="40%" cy="45%" r="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe3ba"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#dab07c"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#a47447"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5c381e"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="cheekLight" cx="40%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f8caa0"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#dca578"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#aa6d47"/>
      <stop offset="95%" stop-color="#693b22"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#412111"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="chestLight" cx="50%" cy="35%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe8c2"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#dcb688"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#9e6e44"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a2c16"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <radialGradient id="handLight" cx="30%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffebc9"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#ddba8e"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#9e6d40"/>
      <stop offset="95%" stop-color="#5e3919"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#321b0b"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Garment Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="dressGold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6e5d33"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#3d351d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a170d"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="dressGreen" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1d261a"/>
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#34432d"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#4a5a3f"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#283321"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#11160e"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="drapeOchre" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#996f3d"/>
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#735026"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#422c11"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f1305"/>

    <!-- Filters for Sfumato Effect -->
    <filter id="sfumato-blur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3"/>
    </filter>
    
    <filter id="heavy-blur" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12"/>
    </filter>

    <filter id="glaze" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
      <feColorMatrix type="matrix" values="
        1.02 0    0    0   0.02
        0    1.01 0    0   0.01
        0    0    0.95 0  -0.02
        0    0    0    1   0"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- ==================== BACKGROUND ==================== -->
  <g id="landscape_background">
    <!-- Sky -->
    <rect width="800" height="700" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>

    <!-- Distant Turquoise Alpine Mountains -->
    <path d="M0,450 L0,320 L50,290 L120,330 L170,280 L230,315 L310,250 L360,285 L400,270 L480,310 L540,240 L620,295 L690,260 L750,300 L800,270 L800,500 L0,500 Z" fill="url(#distantMnt)" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
    <path d="M0,380 Q140,320 280,360 T520,330 Q660,310 800,350 L800,520 L0,520 Z" fill="#4d6e6d" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

    <!-- Sea / Water Bodies -->
    <path d="M70,440 C140,430 220,460 310,435 C350,440 260,470 180,470 C110,470 80,450 70,440 Z" fill="url(#waterGrad)" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
    <path d="M480,430 C560,410 650,450 730,425 C780,430 710,460 620,455 C540,450 490,440 480,430 Z" fill="url(#waterGrad)" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

    <!-- Midground Craggy Rocks & Hills -->
    <!-- Left Side -->
    <path d="M0,530 L0,410 L60,390 L110,430 L160,395 L220,440 L290,420 L330,480 L350,550 L0,560 Z" fill="url(#midMnt)"/>
    <path d="M40,440 Q80,420 120,460 Q90,480 40,440 Z" fill="#66693d" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- Right Side Landscape & Bridge -->
    <path d="M450,530 L490,460 L540,480 L610,400 L680,435 L740,380 L800,410 L800,560 L450,560 Z" fill="url(#midMnt)"/>
    
    <!-- Leonardo's Winding Road (Left) -->
    <path d="M30,520 Q90,515 70,495 T130,475 Q160,480 130,490 T70,510 Q40,525 20,535 Z" fill="url(#roadGrad)" opacity="0.8"/>
    
    <!-- Famous Bridge (Right) -->
    <g id="bridge" opacity="0.85">
      <path d="M680,450 L750,442 L750,455 L680,465 Z" fill="#54442b"/>
      <!-- Arches -->
      <path d="M685,463 A 6,6 0 0,0 697,461 A 6,6 0 0,0 709,459 A 6,6 0 0,0 721,457 A 6,6 0 0,0 733,455" stroke="#2b2416" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Low Terraces / Parapet Wall -->
    <path d="M0,530 L320,530 L320,600 L0,600 Z" fill="url(#parapetGrad)"/>
    <path d="M480,530 L800,530 L800,600 L480,600 Z" fill="url(#parapetGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- Balcony Columns (Bases visible at sides) -->
    <path d="M0,320 L30,320 L35,550 L0,550 Z" fill="#1c1611" opacity="0.7"/>
    <path d="M770,320 L800,320 L800,550 L765,550 Z" fill="#1c1611" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- Column Bases -->
    <path d="M0,510 L45,510 L40,545 L0,545 Z" fill="#2d241c"/>
    <path d="M755,510 L800,510 L800,545 L760,545 Z" fill="#2d241c"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== MONA LISA FIGURE ==================== -->
  <g id="mona_lisa" filter="url(#glaze)">
    
    <!-- Back Hair & Dark Silhouette Mass -->
    <path d="M260,320 Q400,110 540,320 Q610,480 630,650 Q650,830 680,1050 L120,1050 Q150,830 180,630 Q190,440 260,320 Z" fill="url(#hairHalo)"/>

    <!-- Torso and Dress Base -->
    <path d="M240,580 Q190,750 140,1050 L660,1050 Q610,750 560,580 Q480,620 400,620 Q320,620 240,580 Z" fill="#171e14"/>

    <!-- ================= CHEST & DECOLLETAGE ================= -->
    <g id="chest_and_neck">
      <!-- Neck Base -->
      <path d="M345,360 Q340,470 330,520 Q400,550 460,520 Q455,460 450,360 Z" fill="#7d5332"/>
      <!-- Decolletage -->
      <path d="M330,480 C325,550 300,580 300,600 C350,640 440,640 495,595 C495,575 470,540 465,480 Z" fill="url(#chestLight)"/>
      <!-- Soft Shadow under Neck / Clavicle -->
      <path d="M335,505 C370,545 425,545 460,505 C435,530 365,530 335,505 Z" fill="#523219" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      <!-- Delicate Clavicle Indentation -->
      <path d="M360,535 Q400,555 435,535" stroke="#7a4b27" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      
      <!-- Chemise / White Frill Pleats -->
      <!-- Gathered delicate white fabric edge lining neckline -->
      <path d="M295,598 Q305,585 320,593 T345,593 T370,598 T395,601 T420,601 T445,598 T470,593 T495,593" fill="none" stroke="#e0dacf" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>
      <path d="M295,598 Q305,585 320,593 T345,593 T370,598 T395,601 T420,601 T445,598 T470,593 T495,593" fill="none" stroke="#574933" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2,5"/>
      <!-- Inner chemise shadow -->
      <path d="M315,590 C360,610 435,610 480,585 L485,597 C435,622 360,622 310,597 Z" fill="#a89a80" opacity="0.4"/>
    </g>

    <!-- ================= HEAD & FACE ================= -->
    <g id="head">
      <!-- Head Base Structure -->
      <path d="M285,320 C270,190 520,180 515,320 C520,400 505,485 450,515 C390,545 320,510 295,450 C285,400 285,350 285,320 Z" fill="url(#foreheadLight)"/>

      <!-- Cheeks & Lower Face Volume (Soft Tone Laying) -->
      <path d="M292,360 C290,440 330,515 395,520 C465,520 500,450 502,360 C505,440 460,505 400,505 C340,505 295,430 292,360 Z" fill="url(#cheekLight)" opacity="0.8"/>

      <!-- Sfumato Shadows - Cheeks and Jawline Contour -->
      <path d="M290,360 C285,450 330,515 400,522 C370,520 335,490 315,440 C300,400 295,360 290,360 Z" fill="#4d2f16" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      <path d="M505,360 C510,430 465,500 405,522 C435,515 475,480 490,430 C505,385 505,360 505,360 Z" fill="#422510" opacity="0.7" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

      <!-- Temple & Forehead Recede -->
      <path d="M290,300 C300,220 370,200 400,200 C460,200 500,240 505,300 C490,230 440,215 400,215 C350,215 305,240 290,300 Z" fill="#4a301a" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

      <!-- Chin Dimple / Mound -->
      <ellipse cx="400" cy="485" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#dfb384" opacity="0.6"/>
      <path d="M380,497 C395,504 410,504 425,497 C415,502 390,502 380,497 Z" fill="#543118" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

      <!-- ================= NOSE ================= -->
      <g id="nose">
        <!-- Nose Bridge Shadow (Left Side shading gives 3/4 turn depth) -->
        <path d="M382,315 L384,405 L372,425 L380,435 L395,435 L405,430 L402,405 L396,315 Z" fill="url(#noseLight)"/>
        <!-- Soft Ridge Shadow (Left Side Falloff) -->
        <path d="M380,320 Q386,375 375,420 Q380,430 388,435 Q380,420 385,370 Q389,330 380,320 Z" fill="#694121" opacity="0.55" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <!-- Nose Tip Highlight -->
        <ellipse cx="395" cy="423" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#ffeacc" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <!-- Nose Ball & Nostrils Under-Shadow -->
        <path d="M375,427 C378,438 412,438 417,426 C425,433 368,437 375,427 Z" fill="#381b0a" opacity="0.8"/>
        <!-- Nostril Accents -->
        <ellipse cx="377" cy="428" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#261005" opacity="0.8"/>
        <ellipse cx="411" cy="426" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#2b1407" opacity="0.7"/>
        <!-- Septum Highlight -->
        <path d="M390,432 Q396,434 402,431" stroke="#f0caa0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
      </g>

      <!-- ================= EYES ================= -->
      <!-- Masterful Leonardo Sfumato: No sharp outlines, smoky sockets -->
      <g id="eyes">
        <!-- Eyebrow Ridges (No distinct hair, per Renaissance pluck / fading) -->
        <path d="M325,320 Q355,305 380,318" stroke="#63452a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <path d="M412,318 Q440,305 470,322" stroke="#63452a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        
        <!-- Left Eye Socket Shadowing -->
        <ellipse cx="350" cy="338" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#54371e" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <!-- Right Eye Socket Shadowing -->
        <ellipse cx="440" cy="338" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#54371e" opacity="0.38" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

        <!-- Left Eye (Viewer's Left) -->
        <g id="left_eye">
          <!-- Sclera (Warm Aged Tone, never pure white) -->
          <path d="M334,340 C342,333 360,332 370,341 C362,347 344,347 334,340 Z" fill="#d9cfbe"/>
          <!-- Iris Shadow / Depth -->
          <ellipse cx="354" cy="339" rx="7.5" ry="7.5" fill="#302213"/>
          <circle cx="354" cy="339" r="6" fill="#47341c"/>
          <circle cx="354" cy="339" r="3.5" fill="#150e07"/>
          <!-- Subdued Iris Glow -->
          <path d="M352,341 A 4,4 0 0,0 356,341" stroke="#6e522d" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
          <circle cx="352.5" cy="337.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.4"/>
          <!-- Upper Eyelid Fold & Sfumato Edge -->
          <path d="M330,338 C340,328 362,328 374,339" stroke="#331e10" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
          <path d="M331,338 C341,326 363,326 373,338" stroke="#1c0f07" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>
          <!-- Lower Lid Line (Soft) -->
          <path d="M335,342 C345,348 360,348 369,342" stroke="#5a3c25" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
          <path d="M328,348 Q352,357 375,347" stroke="#422b19" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.2" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        </g>

        <!-- Right Eye (Viewer's Right) -->
        <g id="right_eye">
          <!-- Sclera -->
          <path d="M424,341 C433,333 450,334 459,341 C452,347 434,347 424,341 Z" fill="#d4cac0"/>
          <!-- Iris Shadow -->
          <ellipse cx="440" cy="340" rx="7.5" ry="7.5" fill="#302213"/>
          <circle cx="440" cy="340" r="6" fill="#47341c"/>
          <circle cx="440" cy="340" r="3.5" fill="#150e07"/>
          <!-- Reflection -->
          <circle cx="438.5" cy="338.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45"/>
          <!-- Upper Lid -->
          <path d="M421,339 C431,329 452,329 462,340" stroke="#331e10" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
          <path d="M422,340 C431,328 451,328 461,339" stroke="#1c0f07" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>
          <!-- Lower Lid -->
          <path d="M424,342 C434,348 449,348 458,342" stroke="#5a3c25" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
          <path d="M418,348 Q441,357 464,347" stroke="#422b19" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

      </g>

      <!-- ================= THE SMILE ================= -->

        <!-- Philtrum -->
        <path d="M392,434 Q394,446 388,452" stroke="#7a5130" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <path d="M399,434 Q401,446 405,452" stroke="#7a5130" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

        <!-- The Elusive Mouth Smudge (Perception trick: corners blend into shadow) -->
        <ellipse cx="363" cy="460" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#3d2011" opacity="0.55" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        <ellipse cx="432" cy="461" rx="8" ry="5.5" fill="#30180b" opacity="0.65" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>

        <!-- Upper Lip -->
        <path d="M365,461 C377,453 392,453 397,456 C402,453 418,453 430,461 C418,458 402,460 397,461 C392,460 376,457 365,461 Z" fill="#804a37"/>
        <path d="M365,461 C377,453 392,453 397,456 C402,453 418,453 430,461 Z" fill="#54281b" opacity="0.6"/>

        <!-- Lip Part / Smile Curve (The famous enigmatic line) -->
        <path d="M362,460 C373,462 386,464 397,464 C409,464 423,461 434,459" stroke="#2b1208" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

        <!-- Lower Lip -->
        <path d="M368,462 C379,463 390,472 399,472 C409,472 419,464 429,461 C422,471 408,476 398,476 C387,476 374,471 368,462 Z" fill="#9e5d48"/>
        <!-- Lower Lip Plump Highlight -->
        <ellipse cx="398" cy="469" rx="11" ry="3.5" fill="#c7866e" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
        
        <!-- Soft Shadow under Lower Lip -->
        <path d="M377,476 C387,481 407,481 418,476 C409,484 386,484 377,476 Z" fill="#452312" opacity="0.65" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- ================= VEIL & HAIR DETAILS ================= -->
    <g id="veil_and_hair_strands">
      <!-- Translucent Veil over Forehead -->
      <path d="M292,250 C330,225 460,225 500,250 L503,260 C460,237 330,237 290,260 Z" fill="#f0ebd8" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      <!-- Veil Edge Running Down Shoulders -->
      <path d="M288,252 Q260,380 250,560" stroke="#d5cfbe" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.3"/>
      <path d="M501,252 Q535,380 545,560" stroke="#d5cfbe" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.3"/>
      <!-- Veil Sheer Body Sheen -->

      <!-- Wavy Dark Curls framing face -->
      <!-- Left side tresses -->
      <path d="M295,310 Q280,350 288,380 T280,440 T288,510 T270,590 T260,680" stroke="#1d130c" stroke-width="8" fill="none" opacity="0.9" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      <path d="M302,325 Q290,360 296,395 T290,460 T298,520 T280,600" stroke="#3b2614" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
      <path d="M285,350 Q273,380 280,410 T272,480" stroke="#54371d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- Right side tresses -->
      <path d="M495,310 Q515,350 505,385 T515,450 T502,520 T520,600 T535,690" stroke="#1d130c" stroke-width="9" fill="none" opacity="0.9" filter="url(#sfumato-blur)"/>
      <path d="M490,325 Q500,360 495,395 T505,465 T495,530 T510,610" stroke="#3b2614" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
      <path d="M502,350 Q515,385 508,415 T518,485" stroke="#54371d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- ================= GARMENTS & DRAPERY ================= -->
    <g id="dress_details">
      <!-- Pleated Bodice (Gorgiera/Grown Front) -->
      <path d="M310,602 L485,602 L465,720 L330,720 Z" fill="url(#dressGreen)"/>
      
      <!-- Deep Silk Folds on Chest (Dark Greens/Olive Browns) -->
      <path d="M330,602 Q350,650 340,720" stroke="#182116" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M360,603 Q375,650 368,720" stroke="#182116" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M390,604 Q400,660 398,720" stroke="#182116" stroke-width="7" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M425,604 Q425,660 428,720" stroke="#182116" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M455,602 Q445,650 458,720" stroke="#182116" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>

      <!-- Gold Embroidered Border along neckline (Fretwork/Grotesque band) -->

      <path d="M315,604 E350,612 445,610 480,603" stroke="#8c7a43" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" fill="none"/>

      <!-- Sleeves (Warm Terracotta Ochre Tone, distinct from bodice) -->
      <!-- Left Upper Arm/Sleeve (Viewer's Right side of dress) -->
      <path d="M480,600 Q560,630 580,740 Q540,780 490,750 Q510,660 480,600 Z" fill="url(#drapeOchre)"/>
      <!-- Right Sleeve (Viewer's Left side) -->
      <path d="M310,600 Q240,650 215,750 Q260,780 305,740 Q285,660 310,600 Z" fill="url(#drapeOchre)"/>
      
      <!-- Heavy Silk Creases in Sleeves -->
      <path d="M230,710 Q260,680 295,700" stroke="#261706" stroke-width="8" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
      <path d="M220,740 Q255,715 285,730" stroke="#261706" stroke-width="6" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
      <path d="M500,690 Q535,675 565,715" stroke="#261706" stroke-width="8" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 1100" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Lighting and Atmosphere Gradients -->

      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#232617"/>

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0d05"/>

      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#4d3615"/>

      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.05"/>

  <!-- ================= MONA LISA FIGURE ================= -->

      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#e8d5b7;stop-opacity:1" />

    <linearGradient id="hairGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#3d2418;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#2c1810;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Background gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#87CEEB;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#98D8E8;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#B0E0E6;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Shadow filter -->
    <filter id="shadow">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3"/>
      <feOffset dx="2" dy="2" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.3"/>
      <feComposite in2="offsetblur" operator="in"/>

        <feMergeNode/>

question: mona-lisa-svg
prompt: Draw the Mona Lisa as an SVG.
content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 900" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients for atmospheric background -->
    <radialGradient id="bgGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a5240" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#2a2e20" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#12140d" />
    </radialGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="mountainGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3d4a35" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a2113" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="riverGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a6a55" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a352a" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Gradients for clothing -->
    <linearGradient id="mantleGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0d0a06" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#241b10" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="dressGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="50%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3a2a15" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#1a120a" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0805" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Gradients for face and hands -->
    <radialGradient id="faceGrad" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d4b48a" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#a6845a" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6b523a" />
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="handGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a6845a" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#856543" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Sfumato (soft blending) filter -->
    <filter id="softBlur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" />
    </filter>
    <filter id="heavyBlur" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="15" />
    </filter>
    <filter id="textureBlur" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" />
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .skin-shadow { fill: #6b523a; opacity: 0.6; }
    .skin-highlight { fill: #e6ccaa; opacity: 0.5; }
    .hair-base { fill: #0a0705; }
    .veil { fill: #1a2418; opacity: 0.65; }
    .lace { fill: none; stroke: #c4a468; stroke-width: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background Sky / Atmosphere -->
  <rect width="600" height="900" fill="url(#bgGrad)" />

  <!-- Distant Landscape Elements -->
  <g id="landscape" filter="url(#softBlur)">
    <!-- Left Mountains -->
    <path d="M 0,450 Q 80,380 150,420 T 280,480 L 280,650 L 0,650 Z" fill="url(#mountainGrad)" opacity="0.8" />
    <!-- Right River / Valley -->
    <path d="M 600,400 Q 520,450 450,420 T 320,480 L 320,650 L 600,650 Z" fill="url(#riverGrad)" opacity="0.7" />
    <!-- Winding Path -->
    <path d="M 280,650 C 260,550 330,500 280,400 C 250,350 320,300 300,250" fill="none" stroke="#7a8a70" stroke-width="25" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#heavyBlur)" />
    <!-- Right Bridge -->
    <path d="M 380,390 L 460,390 L 460,400 L 380,400 Z" fill="#5a6a55" opacity="0.5" />
    <path d="M 390,400 Q 405,420 420,400 M 425,400 Q 440,420 455,400" fill="none" stroke="#3a4a35" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5" />
  </g>

  <!-- Base Balustrade -->
  <g id="balustrade">
    <path d="M 0,650 L 600,650 L 600,900 L 0,900 Z" fill="#12100a" />
    <path d="M 0,660 L 600,660 L 600,680 L 0,680 Z" fill="#1c1812" opacity="0.8" />
    <!-- Left Pillar Base -->
    <path d="M 0,650 L 60,650 L 60,900 L 0,900 Z" fill="#0a0805" />
    <!-- Right Pillar Base -->
    <path d="M 540,650 L 600,650 L 600,900 L 540,900 Z" fill="#0a0805" />
  </g>

  <!-- Main Figure Group -->
  <g id="mona-lisa">
    <!-- Mantle / Outer Robe (Shoulders and upper body) -->
    <path d="M 120,900 L 120,700 C 120,550 180,480 300,480 C 420,480 480,550 480,700 L 480,900 Z" fill="url(#mantleGrad)" />
    
    <!-- Dress (Chest and torso) -->
    <path d="M 210,900 L 210,650 C 210,520 250,500 300,500 C 350,500 390,520 390,650 L 390,900 Z" fill="url(#dressGrad)" />

    <!-- Dress Folds and Shadows -->
    <g filter="url(#softBlur)" opacity="0.7">
      <path d="M 230,600 Q 260,700 240,900" fill="none" stroke="#0a0502" stroke-width="15" />
      <path d="M 370,600 Q 340,700 360,900" fill="none" stroke="#0a0502" stroke-width="15" />
      <path d="M 300,500 L 300,900" fill="none" stroke="#2a1d10" stroke-width="10" />
    </g>

    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M 275,380 Q 300,440 325,380 Z" fill="#b89878" />
    <!-- Neck Shadow -->
    <path d="M 275,380 Q 300,440 325,380 Q 300,420 275,380 Z" fill="#6b523a" opacity="0.7" filter="url(#softBlur)" />

    <!-- Hands -->
    <g id="hands">

      <path d="M 210,650 C 190,620 200,580 240,580 C 270,580 280,620 260,650 Z" fill="url(#dressGrad)" />
      <!-- Left Hand (Underneath) -->
      <path d="M 210,650 C 180,650 160,680 170,710 C 180,740 220,730 240,700 Z" fill="url(#handGrad)" />
      <!-- Fingers of Left Hand -->
      <path d="M 170,710 Q 160,720 165,730 Q 175,735 185,725 Z" fill="#856543" />

      <path d="M 390,650 C 420,650 440,680 430,710 C 420,740 380,730 360,700 Z" fill="url(#handGrad)" />

      <g filter="url(#textureBlur)">
        <!-- Index Finger -->
        <path d="M 380,680 C 360,670 330,670 310,690 C 300,700 310,710 320,710 C 340,710 360,690 380,690 Z" fill="#a6845a" />
        <!-- Middle Finger -->
        <path d="M 370,695 C 350,685 320,690 300,710 C 290,720 300,730 310,730 C 330,730 350,710 370,705 Z" fill="#b89878" />
        <!-- Ring Finger -->
        <path d="M 360,710 C 340,700 310,710 290,730 C 280,740 290,750 300,750 C 320,750 340,730 360,720 Z" fill="#a6845a" />
        <!-- Knuckle Shadows -->
        <path d="M 310,690 Q 320,685 330,690" fill="none" stroke="#6b523a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" />
        <path d="M 300,710 Q 310,705 320,710" fill="none" stroke="#6b523a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" />
      </g>
      <!-- Hand Shadows -->
      <path d="M 250,700 Q 300,720 350,700 Q 300,740 250,700 Z" fill="#6b523a" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#softBlur)" />
    </g>

    <!-- Face Base -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="800" viewBox="0 0 600 800" role="img" aria-label="Stylized vector rendering inspired by the Mona Lisa">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9db4b6"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#6f8b8d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#445b5e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="landGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4c5a3d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c3827"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Skin tones -->
    <radialGradient id="skinGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f1d6b6" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#e7c79f" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#caa77f" />
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Hair -->
    <linearGradient id="hairGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2b2017"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0f0c0a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Dress / shawl -->
    <linearGradient id="dressGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1b221d"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#2a3b2f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a201b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sashGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7f5c2e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5d431f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Lips -->
    <linearGradient id="lipGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b27261"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8a594c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Shadows -->
    <radialGradient id="shadowGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)" />
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Subtle paper texture via noise pattern -->
    <filter id="paper">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="1" seed="3" result="noise"/>
      <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0.2" />
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="table" tableValues="0 0.05"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feBlend in="SourceGraphic" in2="noise" mode="multiply"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>
